1. 성전공사 재개와 완공: 1. The Temple Work Resumes and Is Completed
<스5:1> 선지자들 곧 선지자 학개와 잇도의 손자 스가랴가 이스라엘 하:
<Ezra 5:1> Then the prophets, Haggai the prophet, and Zechariah the son of Iddo, prophesied unto the Jews that were in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel, even unto them.
- That's Haggai and Zechariah, which we just studied.
<스5:2> 이에 스알디엘의 아들 스룹바벨과 요사닥의 아들 예수아가 일어:
<Ezra 5:2> Then rose up Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and began to build the house of God which is at Jerusalem: and with them were the prophets of God helping them.
 - People have to be willing to do it first; then the prophets can help, and God can help.
 - Once the building starts again, Tatnai the governor west of the river, Shetharboznai, and their companions come picking a fight again.
그래서 이번에는 다리오왕에게 고레스의 조서를 한번 찾아보라고 건의를 해요: So this time they suggest to King Darius that he go look for Cyrus's decree.
<스6:1~2> 이에 다리오 왕이 조서를 내려 서적 곳간 곧 바벨론에서:
<Ezra 6:1~2> Then Darius the king made a decree, and search was made in the house of the rolls, where the treasures were laid up in Babylon. And there was found at Achmetha, in the palace that is in the province of the Medes, a roll, and therein was a record thus written:
 - Darius was Zerubbabel's friend, and when the petition came in he looked into it — and what do you know, the official building permit for the temple turned up!
잘 됐다 이노무 쉐키들 방해하려고 민원 넣고 난리 치더니 허가서가 나왔으: "Good! These rascals filed complaints and raised a ruckus to block it, but now the permit's turned up, so they'd better shut their mouths."
그래서 왕이‘당장 성전 건축을 돕고 방해하는 놈은 다 죽이고 그 집을 거: So the king gave a strict order: 'Help build the temple right now, and anyone who gets in the way — kill them all and turn their house into a dunghill.'
And so, the story goes, the work went ahead without a hitch.
<스6:13~15> 다리오 왕의 조서가 내리매 강 서편 총독 닷드내와 스:
<Ezra 6:13~15> Then Tatnai, governor on this side the river, Shetharboznai, and their companions, according to that which Darius the king had sent, so they did speedily. And the elders of the Jews builded, and they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. And they builded, and finished it, according to the commandment of the God of Israel, and according to the commandment of Cyrus, and Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia. And this house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.
 - The people who had tried to block it got a good scare and helped quickly, so it was completed in B.C 516 — restored exactly 70 years after the temple was destroyed.
2. 이스라엘 백성들의 회복: 2. The Restoration of the People of Israel
<스6:16~22> 이스라엘 자손과 제사장들과 레위 사람들과 기타 사로잡:
<Ezra 6:16~22> And the children of Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the rest of the children of the captivity, kept the dedication of this house of God with joy, And offered at the dedication of this house of God an hundred bullocks, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin offering for all Israel, twelve he goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel. And they set the priests in their divisions, and the Levites in their courses, for the service of God, which is at Jerusalem; as it is written in the book of Moses. And the children of the captivity kept the passover upon the fourteenth day of the first month. For the priests and the Levites were purified together, all of them were pure, and killed the passover for all the children of the captivity, and for their brethren the priests, and for themselves. And the children of Israel, which were come again out of captivity, and all such as had separated themselves unto them from the filthiness of the heathen of the land, to seek the LORD God of Israel, did eat, And kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy: for the LORD had made them joyful, and turned the heart of the king of Assyria unto them, to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of God, the God of Israel.
 1) They held the temple dedication
 2) They set up the priests' divisions (duty rotations) again and served in the temple
 3) They kept the Passover
 4) They put away the filthy things of the heathen
 - That's Part 1 of Ezra. Then comes the time of Esther, and chapters 7~10 tell the story of the second Return, led by Ezra.
Now, at this time in Persia, there was an incident where the Jews were nearly wiped out.
